findings.title: Orientation recovered from a lost course

findings.mechanism: The focus participle carries loss of place or direction and the following focus verb carries directed recovery; 34:24 and 16:9 independently place ضلال against hdy, while 90:10 and 1:6 supply opened and straight-course contacts, so the focus relation is read as recoverable orientation.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the condition as an unsettled course that receives a concrete return of bearing, without having to make blame the starting point.
findings.containment: The ordinary translation remains intact; this does not erase moral uses of ضلال, activate hiddenness or lost-animal senses, or assert that every guidance act is a completed moral reclassification.

epistemic.reason: The anchored publication and focus branches are trusted, while the supplied connection targets provide exact Arabic but not target morphology, so the wider polarity is qualified rather than treated as a lexical verdict.

findings.title: From stray condition to reportable openness
findings.claim: The focus stray branch can be revisited through the 93:8 directionless-stray image and the 93:11 disclosure turn, so guidance has a later consequence of bringing a once-unlocated condition into responsible speech.
findings.mechanism: The focus B005 carrier is joined to the attributed B008 context carrier in 93:8; 93:11 supplies the independent openness trigger and 5:26 supplies wider wandering, making the changed reading a bounded aftermath rather than a new lexical definition.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees that recovery is not complete concealment: a guided person may become able to speak about what was previously unlocated without turning disclosure into shame.
findings.containment: This does not activate the unresolved ح د ث/B006 branch, does not claim that 93:11 is a global semantic continuation of hdy by itself, and preserves the ordinary lost-animal and route senses as alternatives.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective support and context image are legacy-unbound, while the wider 5:26 target is exact but lacks target morphology; the report consequence is therefore exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahibinden ayrılmış ve sahibinin kim olduğu bilinmeyen kayıp hayvanı adlandırır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus lost-animal branch supplies the once-unlocated dependent whose condition is revisited.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 93:8 supplies the adjacent stray-direction confirmation and 5:26 supplies a wider wandering contact.
branch_activations.activation: The focus carrier meets the two wandering contacts before the later disclosure turn, so the lost condition can be retrospectively read as recoverable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus condition is not an irreversible disappearance but a state that can become speakable after guidance.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains a contextual retrospective; it does not make ownerlessness the only sense or add a literal animal.

findings.title: A renewal contact after being lost
findings.claim: The focus finding act can be placed beside a wider question about being lost in the earth and entering a new creation, allowing وَجَدَكَ to suggest recovery into a newly restored condition.
findings.mechanism: The exact focus carrier meets 32:10's supplied loss-and-newness contact; the connection returns through the finding act, so a newness pressure colors what it means to be found without changing وَجَدَكَ into a creation verb.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the found condition as a recovery that makes a new beginning perceptible, not only as locating something that was already unchanged.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory wider resonance from a reciprocal connection with no target morphology and no branch support citation; it does not assert a creation doctrine or activate the separate existence branch.

epistemic.reason: 32:10 provides exact target Arabic and a reciprocal discovery contact, but its target morphology is explicitly unavailable and no trusted support is attached.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yeni olma ve yenilenme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Henüz üzerinden günler geçmemiş, yeni yapılmış veya yeniden yeni olmuş bulunma ana anlamdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus وَجَدَكَ form carries the act of finding the addressed person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 32:10 supplies the separate contact of being lost in the earth and asking about a new creation.
branch_activations.activation: The finding carrier meets the loss-and-newness question, allowing recovery to be felt as a renewed condition rather than mere detection.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The found person can also be perceived as newly restored after a state of loss.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb is not translated as newness or creation, and the target's missing morphology prevents a stronger claim.

findings.title: Guidance as leading ahead
findings.claim: The focus guidance act can briefly be perceived through the image of a guide who moves ahead and thereby gives direction to others.
findings.mechanism: The focus هَدَىٰ carrier meets 13:7's wider guide-agent contact; the supplied front-and-leading branch turns the act's direction into a visible leading relation while preserving the core sense of showing a course.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can picture guidance as a path made usable by someone or something that goes ahead, not merely as information stated from nowhere.
findings.containment: The branch's core is positional and its leading-guide use is associated; the target morphology is not supplied, so this is exploratory and does not assert a human guide, etymology, or universal leadership claim.

epistemic.reason: 13:7 supplies an exact guide-agent contact, but the connection target has no supplied morphology and the front-leading branch is uncandidate evidence used as a bounded surprise.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus guidance verb carries movement toward a direction that can be pictured as ahead.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 13:7 supplies the wider guide-agent relation for every community.
branch_activations.activation: The focus direction act meets the front-position relation, making the way perceptible as something led from ahead.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Guidance has a visible leading edge as well as an abstract directional content.
branch_activations.boundary: The core branch concerns being first or forward; it does not make every front part a guide.

branch_activations.boundary: This is a bounded associated image; it does not claim that the focus verb is a noun for a guide or that a physical staff is present.
